notes: Variant assumption is a high-pulley standing cable pushdown with the upper arm near the torso. Visible roles are intentionally limited to Triceps brachii. Direct studies discuss long, lateral, and medial heads separately, but the local anatomy model exposes only the aggregate Triceps brachii mesh. No secondary or support muscles were added because forearm, shoulder, and trunk contributions were either unavailable in anatomy or not central enough for a concise visible app role.
